title: Rory and the Starflower Hill
verses:
The evening winds were whispering,
Across the gentle velvet hill,
Where Rory walked with quiet steps,
While all the woods grew calm and still.

Then Nia drifted from the heights,
With starlight on her peaceful wing,
To show the friends a sleepy path
Where silver crickets softly sing.

And Ricky hopped along the trail,
And slowed his tired, bouncy feet,
While Psittaco curled in the moss,
To smell the blossoms pure and sweet.

Now Benny rested near the ferns,
Beneath the evening's dusky glow,
And Tilly made a cozy ring,
Where sleepy breezes gently blow.

The starflowers opened one by one,
To shine with golden candlelight,
As Rory curled upon the moss,
To welcome in the quiet night.

The moon climbed high above the hill,
Where shadows gathered blue and deep,
And Rory closed his happy eyes,
To drift into a peaceful sleep.
